categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the leather manufacturing segment, producing leather fabric mainly for car seats and other applications. It also has a real estate rental segment involving property leasing in Seoul, Gyeonggi, and Busan. The leather segment accounts for the vast majority of revenue, while the rental segment contributes a minor portion.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company imports raw hides and processes them into leather fabric using established tanning and finishing technologies. It emphasizes quality control and technical development to produce high value-added products, including automotive seat leather. Production capacity is based on standardized 8-hour workdays and includes both domestic and overseas facilities, notably a local subsidiary in Qingdao, China.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers of automotive seats, footwear, and other leather goods, with sales split between domestic (84.1%) and export markets (15.9%). The company targets emerging industrial countries in China and Southeast Asia for footwear leather and maintains strong relationships with global footwear buyers. The automotive sector is a strategic market for high-quality car seat leather.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are centered in South Korea with production facilities in Gunpo and overseas in Qingdao, China. Sales cover domestic Korean markets and export markets primarily in China, South America, and Southeast Asia. The company imports raw materials mainly from the United States and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the leather supply chain, processing raw hides into finished leather fabric supplied as intermediate goods to manufacturers of finished leather products such as car seats and footwear. It imports raw materials and sells processed leather to downstream manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product quality, cost reduction, and innovation focused on high value-added leather products like automotive seat leather and furniture leather. R&D activities center on physical property testing and product development to meet buyer specifications. The company pursues diversification of customers and continuous improvement in production efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of leather fabric both domestically and internationally. A smaller portion of revenue comes from real estate rental income. Sales are conducted via direct export and local sales channels, with payment terms including letters of credit and local promissory notes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition from Chinese and South American leather producers, especially in the footwear segment. It positions itself as a high-quality, technologically advanced supplier with differentiated products such as automotive seat leather. It is recognized as a designated supplier by major global footwear buyers, indicating a strong competitive position in quality and reliability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 179 billion KRW in 2023, with a slight increase of 0.3% from the previous year. Net income grew significantly by 43.3%, supported by lower raw material prices. The company maintains a strong financial structure with a low debt ratio (1.61%) and high equity ratio (95%), along with robust liquidity indicated by a current ratio over 2200%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior quality control, advanced technology, and product differentiation in high value-added leather products, particularly automotive seat leather. Its local production in China supports competitive pricing and responsiveness to customer needs. The company’s ability to customize leather to buyer specifications and maintain stable supply relationships with major global buyers underpins its competitive advantage.
